full_prompt_en: A square experimental time-lapse photograph shows a sunset over a flat reflective shoreline, with overlapping translucent rectangular exposures rising in the center. The upper half of the frame is deep navy blue, nearly unbroken except for faint cloud texture toward the left. A narrow horizon runs across the middle, separating the darkening sky from calm water and wet ground. At the far left, low smoky clouds carry a faint red-violet line close to the horizon. At the right, the horizon remains spare and nearly black. The central light is arranged as a stepped stack of semi-transparent vertical panels, each holding a slightly different position or brightness of the sinking sun. Some panels reach higher than their neighbors, making an uneven skyline of pale peach and blue-gray rectangles against the open dark sky. Within them, the sun and orange cloud bands repeat with small shifts. The warm band grows brightest near the lower center, where several exposures overlap. Along the lower half, the orange light reflects through shallow water as broken vertical strokes and smears, with each slice contributing another shifted reflection. The surrounding foreground is much darker, showing only a thin wet sheen and faint horizontal ripples. A small dark cluster along the central horizon interrupts the glow, but its details are lost in the backlight. The light comes directly from the low sun, flaring softly within the overlapping rectangles and falling quickly into cool blue-black outside them. The image retains photographic grain and gentle blur; the edges of the temporal panels are straight and visibly layered rather than naturally part of the landscape. Nothing in the scene is sharply posed or staged, and no readable text appears. The overall composition concentrates motion of passing time into a bright central column, balancing warm repeated light against an expansive still dark surround.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形实验性延时摄影图像描绘平坦的反光海岸上的日落，中央升起相互重叠的半透明矩形曝光片。画面上半部是深海军蓝，除左侧隐约的云纹外几乎没有中断。一条狭窄地平线横穿中央，把暗下去的天空与平静水面和湿地分开。最左边，低低的烟雾状云在地平线附近带一线淡红紫色。右侧地平线则简洁而近黑。中央光线被排列成阶梯状的半透明竖向画片，每一片都保存下沉太阳稍有不同的位置或亮度。部分画片比邻片更高，在开阔深色天空前形成浅桃色与蓝灰色矩形构成的不齐整天际线。橙色云带和太阳在这些片层内部以小幅偏移反复出现。暖色光带在下方中央最亮，那里有数层曝光重叠。下半部，橙光经浅水反射，变成断续的竖向光痕与涂抹，每个切片都贡献一处略微错位的倒影。周围前景暗得多，只显示一层薄薄湿亮和隐约的横向波纹。中央地平线上的小深色聚簇打断辉光，细节却消失在逆光里。光直接来自低处太阳，在重叠矩形内柔和地炫开，矩形之外迅速落入冷蓝黑。图像保留摄影颗粒与轻微模糊；时间画片的边缘笔直且层层可见，而非风景中自然存在的部分。场景没有清晰摆拍的对象，也无可读文字。整体构图将流逝时间的运动集中为一道明亮中央纵列，以重复暖光平衡四周开阔而静止的黑暗。
style_prompt_en: The experimental photographic image layers semi-transparent exposures of a single view into staggered rectangular time slices. Repeated light bands and slight positional offsets show temporal change while a stable horizon and dark outer field hold the composition together. Deep navy and blue-black occupy most of the frame, allowing a concentrated strip of orange, peach, and pale cream to glow with unusual intensity. Straight panel boundaries remain visible, but their transparency lets clouds, reflections, and tonal bands overlap inside them. Low backlight produces soft flares and elongated reflective marks, with detail falling away toward the perimeter. Fine grain and gentle blur preserve a photographic surface even where the layered geometry looks constructed. Broad negative space around a dense central column gives the image a quiet, contemplative rhythm. The overall effect is meditative and uncanny, turning gradual change into a tangible stack of light without fixing a particular subject.
style_prompt_zh: 这种实验摄影图像把同一视点的半透明曝光层叠成错落的矩形时间切片。重复光带和细小位置偏移显示时间变化，稳定的水平线与深色外部色域则维持构图。深海军蓝与蓝黑占据画面大部分面积，使集中的橙色、桃色和浅奶油色光带显得格外明亮。笔直的片层边界保持可见，透明度又让云状纹理、倒影和明暗色带在片内交叠。低位逆光制造柔和炫光和拉长的反射痕迹，细节朝周边逐渐消失。细颗粒与轻微模糊即使在层叠几何看似人工建构的区域，也保留摄影表面。密集中央纵列周围的宽阔留白给图像安静沉思的节奏。整体效果冥想般而隐约奇异，把渐进变化变成可触的光线叠层，却不限定具体题材。
theme_en: A sunset over reflective water shown as overlapping slices of time
theme_zh: 日落映在水面上，并以重叠的时间切片呈现
name: Time-lapse photography
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
